recipe.title: One-Pan Mediterranean Garlic Herb Chicken and Rice
recipe.description: A comforting chef-crafted one-pan meal featuring succulent seared chicken thighs nestled in fragrant basmati rice infused with garlic, fresh herbs, white wine, and lemon.

ingredients.item: Fresh thyme and oregano, finely chopped
Kosher salt and fresh black pepper

instructions.text: Season chicken thighs generously with smoked paprika, half of the chopped fresh herbs, salt, and black pepper.

Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a wide Dutch oven or braiser over medium-high heat. Sear chicken skin-side down for 5–6 minutes until crisp and golden. Flip and sear for 3 minutes, then set aside on a plate.
Reduce heat to medium and add remaining oil and butter. Sauté diced onion for 4 minutes until translucent, then add minced garlic and remaining fresh herbs, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in rinsed basmati rice and toast with aromatics for 2 minutes, ensuring each grain is coated.
Deglaze the pan with white wine, scraping up all browned bits from the bottom. Simmer for 2 minutes until liquid reduces by half.
Pour in chicken bone broth, lemon zest, and lemon juice. Bring to a simmer, then nestle seared chicken thighs and resting juices back into the pan.
Cover with a tight-fitting lid, reduce heat to low, and cook for 20 minutes until rice is tender and chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Remove from heat, fold fresh baby spinach around the chicken, cover, and allow to rest off heat for 5 minutes to wilt spinach. Garnish with fresh parsley before serving.

tips: Rinsing basmati rice under cold water until it runs clear removes excess surface starch, ensuring fluffy, distinct grains.
If using skin-on thighs, flash the finished dish under an oven broiler uncovered for 2 minutes to restore skin crispiness.
